calibration.method: initial interarrival = median request lifetime / target concurrency; achieved concurrency must be measured later

notes: Intervals are calibrated screening parameters, not claims about production traffic.
The bursty base interval compensates for the stationary-state weighted multiplier of 1.5 so its long-run mean arrival rate matches steady and Poisson.
Calibrate intervals after measuring request lifetime so achieved concurrency matches the target.
Arrival traces may release requests only; they must not alter per-request DAGs or routing.
